figures: 1. ./pass_rate_comparison.png: Comparison of the final pass rate (pass@1) for each method across the problem subset. UT-Repair significantly outperformed the other methods.

2. ./convergence_rate.png: Cumulative pass rate of the repair methods as a function of the number of repair iterations. UT-Repair converges to maximum performance in one iteration, while SMT-Repair makes no progress.
results_section: 1. The UT-Repair method corrected all failing problems in a single repair iteration, reaching its maximum pass rate immediately.
